name: Flash Freeze Lake · Life
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 7-block radius for 4.5 s (water and ground beneath turn to ice). Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Soaked for 16.5 s
• Cold 144: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heals 4 ❤
• Regeneration: +1.5 ❤ every 2 s for 10 s
self_description:
On you:
• Soaked for 16.5 s and leaves a puddle
• Cold 144: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heals 4 ❤
• Regeneration: +1.5 ❤ every 2 s for 10 s
